concepts.title: Arithmetic Progressions and Common Difference
concepts.definition: An arithmetic progression is a list of numbers in which each term is obtained by adding a fixed number, the common difference d, to the preceding term; checking consecutive differences identifies an AP.
concepts.key_idea: One constant difference everywhere: that is the signature of an AP.
question_patterns: check whether the given list of numbers forms an AP
find the common difference of the given AP
write the next three terms of the given AP
which of the given sequences is an AP - justify
find the first term and common difference of the given AP
write an AP with the given first term and common difference

solution_steps.explain: The difference of the first two terms gives d.

concepts.title: nth Term of an AP
concepts.definition: The nth term of an AP with first term a and common difference d is a plus (n - 1)d, since n minus 1 jumps of d lead from the first term to the nth; it also lets you find the position of a given term.
concepts.key_idea: Jump count is n minus 1: add that many d's to the first term.
concepts.textbook_ref: jemh105.txt section 5.2 (nth term of an AP)
question_patterns: find the 10th term of the AP with first term 2 and common difference 7
which term of the AP 3, 8, 13, 18 is 78
find the nth term of the given arithmetic progression
how many terms does the AP contain up to the given last term
find the term of the AP indicated by the position
is the given number a term of the AP - justify

solution_steps.explain: n minus 1 jumps of d from the first term.
The nth term is a plus jumps times d.

concepts.title: Sum of n Terms of an AP
concepts.definition: The sum of the first n terms of an AP equals n over 2 times (2a + (n - 1)d), or equivalently n over 2 times (first + last); pairing terms from the ends explains why each pair contributes the same total.
concepts.key_idea: Pair the ends: n over 2 pairs, each contributing first plus last.
concepts.textbook_ref: jemh105.txt section 5.3 (sum of first n terms of an AP)
question_patterns: find the sum of the first 22 terms of the given AP
find the sum of the first n terms of the AP with a and d given
how many terms of the AP sum to the given total
find the sum of all natural numbers up to the given limit
the sum and number of terms are given - find the last term
calculate the total savings pattern using AP sums

solution_steps.explain: 2a plus (n - 1)d is twice the average term.
Half the number of terms times the bracket gives the sum.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the nth term of the AP with first term {a} and common difference {d}.
An AP begins at {a} with common difference {d}. What is term number {n}?

solution_template.explain: a plus jumps times d is the answer.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the sum of the first {n} terms of the AP with first term {a} and common difference {d}.

solution_template.explain: The product is the required sum.

worked_examples.question_pattern: For the AP starting at {a} with difference {d}, find the total of the first {n} terms.

solution_template.explain: Twice the first term plus the jump total.
The result is the sum of n terms.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the common difference of the AP whose first two terms are {first} and {second}.
The first two terms of a list are {first} and {second}. Find its common difference to test whether it is an AP.

solution_template.explain: The difference is the candidate common difference.
